caption: The drawing depicts a close-up view of a bonnet or cap, primarily cream or off-white in color with a subtle sheen, suggesting a satiny or silky material. The bonnet has structured detailing at the crown with a gathered section towards the back, held together with two pink ribbons. The brim of the bonnet is broad and curves outward, rendered in a peachy beige color. A long cream-colored ribbon or tie hangs downward from the bonnet. To the right of the bonnet, there is a smaller, simple line sketch of the same object, showing its overall shape and gathered detail without color or shading. The background is plain and unadorned, with an off-white or very light beige tone.
title: Shaker Bonnet
